components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default blue action with firm corners and a short lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:.9rem 1.25rem; border:0; border-radius:var(--radius-button, .5rem); color:var(--color-surface, #fff); background:var(--color-primary, #0078d0); font:600 1rem var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); box-shadow:var(--shadow-card, 0 18px 40px -24px rgb(13 21 38 / 40%)); transition:background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-primary-hover, #0063ad); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-brand-amber, #ffb114); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Header CTA
components.description: Persistent pill-shaped contact action used once in the header.
components.css: .ds-header-cta { display:inline-flex; min-height:3rem; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:.75rem 1.5rem; border-radius:9999px; color:var(--color-surface, #fff); background:var(--color-primary, #0078d0); font:600 .9rem var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; transition:background 160ms ease; } .ds-header-cta:hover { background:var(--color-primary-hover, #0063ad); } .ds-header-cta:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-brand-amber, #ffb114); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-header-cta:active { background:var(--color-primary-hover, #0063ad); }

components.name: Hero Primary Link
components.description: White inverse action for a Lab Navy hero or CTA.
components.css: .ds-btn-inverse { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:.75rem 1.75rem; border-radius:999px; color:var(--color-ink, #0d1526); background:var(--color-surface, #fff); font:650 1rem var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; transition:transform 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-inverse:hover { background:rgb(255 255 255 / 85%); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-inverse:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-brand-amber, #ffb114); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-btn-inverse:active { transform:translateY(0); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: White form field with a cool border and explicit focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.45rem; color:var(--color-text, #4b5565); font:650 1rem var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { display:block; } .ds-input { width:100%; border:1px solid #b8c3bd; border-radius:var(--radius-button, 8px); padding:.8rem .9rem; background:var(--color-surface, #fff); color:var(--color-text, #4b5565); font:400 1rem var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--color-muted, #7c8698); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--color-primary, #0078d0); outline:3px solid rgb(0 120 208 / 20%); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Compact desktop navigation label with a blue hover signal.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; } .ds-nav-item { display:inline-flex; min-height:2.75rem; align-items:center; padding:.65rem .8rem; color:var(--color-ink, #0d1526); font:500 .82rem var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; transition:color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color:var(--color-primary, #0078d0); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-brand-amber, #ffb114); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-nav-item:active { color:var(--color-primary-hover, #0063ad); }

components.name: Text Card
components.description: White technical card with an accent bar and restrained hover elevation.
components.html:
Beam steering

Flexible Scan Patterns

Direct the beam where it is needed.

Learn more →
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:2rem; border-radius:var(--radius-card, 1rem); color:var(--color-text, #4b5565); background:var(--color-surface, #fff); font-family:var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration:none; transition:transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow 300ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-card-bar { width:2.5rem; height:.25rem; margin-bottom:1.5rem; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-brand-blue, #0078d0); } .ds-card-eyebrow { margin:0; color:var(--color-brand-blue, #0078d0); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-card-title { margin:.75rem 0 0; color:var(--color-ink, #0d1526); font:600 clamp(1.25rem, 1.7vw, 1.5rem)/1.15 var(--font-display, Oswald, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card-body { margin:.5rem 0 0; line-height:1.625; } .ds-card-link { margin-top:1.5rem; color:var(--color-brand-blue, #0078d0); font-weight:500; } .ds-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-card, 0 18px 40px -24px rgb(13 21 38 / 40%)); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-brand-amber, #ffb114); outline-offset:4px; } .ds-card:active { transform:translateY(-2px); }

components.name: Dark Technical Panel
components.description: The laboratory stage for mechanism, imagery, and compact specifications.
components.html:
Light Control Metasurface™

Flexible Beam Steering for 3D Sensing

No moving parts.
components.css: .ds-dark-panel { padding:clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem); border-radius:var(--radius-panel, 1.5rem); color:var(--color-surface, #fff); background:var(--color-panel, #0a1226); font-family:var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-dark-eyebrow { margin:0 0 1rem; color:var(--color-brand-amber, #ffb114); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-dark-title { max-width:18ch; margin:0; color:#fff; font:600 clamp(1.7rem, 3vw, 2.4rem)/1.15 var(--font-display, Oswald, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-dark-body { margin:1.25rem 0 0; color:rgb(255 255 255 / 70%); font-size:1.0625rem; line-height:1.65; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Tracked uppercase context label for a section or card.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { margin:0; color:var(--color-brand-blue, #0078d0); font:600 .75rem/1.4 var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Specification Pair
components.description: Compact label-and-value unit used in definition lists and spec panels.
components.css: .ds-spec-pair { margin:0; font-family:var(--font-body, Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-spec-key { color:var(--color-muted, #7c8698); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:600; line-height:1.4; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-spec-value { margin:.5rem 0 0; color:var(--color-ink, #0d1526); font-size:.875rem; line-height:1.375; }

narrative.overview:
Lumotive's visual system should feel like precision engineering observed inside an optical laboratory. Dark navy panels are the lab: controlled, technical spaces that frame mechanisms, media, specifications, and decisive calls to action. Bright blue is the laser: a focused signal for action, active information, and the path through dense technical content.

The system is spacious but not soft. Oswald supplies a compressed, industrial display voice; Poppins keeps explanations, labels, and navigation calm and highly legible. White cards and cool-gray page fields create the clean bench around the dark apparatus. Green, amber, and red are measured spectral accents rather than competing brand voices.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast dark technical stages set into a cool, quiet page field.
Focused blue actions and data cues, supported by sparse spectral accents.
Condensed display type paired with a neutral geometric body face.
Firm rounded geometry, thin borders, and short, exact hover lifts.
Generous section rhythm with compact labels and specification typography.

rules.name: The Laser Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Blue marks the route, action, or measurement; do not turn it into ambient decoration across an entire screen.

rules.name: The Spectral Accent Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red may distinguish adjacent data or cards, but they never compete with blue for the primary action.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Oswald states; Poppins explains. Do not introduce a third typographic voice or use Poppins to imitate display type.

rules.name: The Exact Lift Rule
rules.body: A responsive control may rise 2px and a card 4px; add the one card shadow, never a stack of ornamental shadows.

rules.name: The Radius Has Rank Rule
rules.body: Radius increases with structural scale: control, card, then panel. Do not apply panel rounding to small controls or turn every container into a pill.

dos: Do use Lab Navy as a purposeful technical stage for heroes, mechanism panels, CTAs, and the footer.
Do keep Laser Blue concentrated on actions, links, active data, and small accent bars.
Do preserve the established control-card-panel radius hierarchy and the 5rem default section rhythm.
Do respect reduced-motion preferences by removing reveals, hover translation, smooth scrolling, and autoplaying decorative motion.
donts: Don't spread every spectral accent through the same component; one blue, green, amber, or red signal is enough.
Don't put permanent shadows on every card; tonal separation is the resting state and elevation signals interaction.
Don't soften the system with oversized pill cards, diffuse gradients, or floaty spring motion.
Don't replace compact technical labels with oversized marketing type or mix Oswald into body copy.
